mapper.select: SELECT template_version FROM template_version t WHERE document_type=#{documentType} AND status='APPROVED' ORDER BY template_version

SELECT template_version FROM template_version t WHERE document_type=#{documentType} AND status='APPROVED'
AND template_version IN #{versionId}
AND 1=0
ORDER BY template_version

SELECT r.tenant_id,r.rule_version,r.engine_revision,r.expression,r.basis_manifest,r.status,r.content_sha256, v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,r.schema_version,r.schema_manifest_sha256,r.created_by,r.created_at,r.classification FROM rule_version r JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.version_id=r.rule_version AND v.owner_project_id IS NULL AND v.entity_kind='RULE_VERSION' WHERE r.rule_version=#{upstreamId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT upstream_version_id FROM lineage_edge e WHERE consumer_version_id=#{upstreamId} AND relation_kind='RULE_DEFINITION' ORDER BY upstream_version_id

SELECT d.tenant_id,d.template_version,t.document_type,t.application_path,t.status,d.content_json,d.content_sha256, v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,d.base_version,d.base_version_sha256,d.reason,d.authority_grant,d.authority_revision, d.schema_version,d.schema_manifest_sha256,d.created_by,d.created_at,d.classification,d.revision,t.basis_manifest,t.format_profile,t.condition_schema FROM template_definition d JOIN template_version t ON t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.template_version=d.template_version AND t.content_sha256=d.content_sha256 AND t.schema_version=d.schema_version AND t.schema_manifest_sha256=d.schema_manifest_sha256 AND t.created_by=d.created_by AND t.created_at=d.created_at AND t.classification=d.classification JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND v.version_id=d.template_version AND v.owner_project_id IS NULL AND v.entity_kind='TEMPLATE_VERSION' WHERE d.template_version=#{templateId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT node_id AS id,JSON_OBJECT('node_id',node_id,'parent_id',parent_id,'official_number',official_number,'title',title,'ordinal',ordinal, 'condition',`condition`,'required',JSON_EXTRACT(IF(required,'true','false'),'$'),'content_mode',content_mode,'evidence_rule',evidence_rule) AS content, FROM requirement_node n WHERE template_version=#{templateId} ORDER BY node_id

SELECT field_id AS id,JSON_OBJECT('field_id',field_id,'node_id',node_id,'value_type',value_type,'constraints',constraints, 'condition',`condition`,'evidence_rule',evidence_rule,'output_mapping',output_mapping) AS content, FROM field_definition f WHERE template_version=#{templateId} ORDER BY field_id

SELECT repeat_id AS id,JSON_OBJECT('repeat_id',repeat_id,'row_schema',row_schema,'min_count',CAST(min_count AS CHAR),'max_count',CAST(max_count AS CHAR)) AS content, FROM repeat_definition r WHERE template_version=#{templateId} ORDER BY repeat_id

SELECT attachment_requirement_id AS id,JSON_OBJECT('requirement',requirement_json,'content_sha256',content_sha256) AS content, FROM template_attachment_requirement a WHERE template_version=#{templateId} ORDER BY attachment_requirement_id

SELECT upstream_version AS id,JSON_OBJECT('version_id',upstream_version,'content_sha256',upstream_sha256,'ordinal',ordinal) AS content, FROM template_definition_dependency d WHERE template_version=#{templateId} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT upstream_version_id FROM lineage_edge e WHERE consumer_version_id=#{templateId} AND relation_kind='TEMPLATE_DEFINITION' ORDER BY upstream_version_id
SELECT status FROM rule_version r WHERE rule_version=#{upstreamId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='TP-01' AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{templateId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='template.draft_created'

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='TP-02' AND idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE template_version SET status=#{newStatus} WHERE template_version=#{templateId} AND status=#{oldStatus} AND content_sha256=#{hash}
UPDATE template_definition SET revision=#{resulting} WHERE template_version=#{templateId} AND revision=#{expected} AND content_sha256=#{hash}
UPDATE tenant SET governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE governance_epoch=#{governanceEpoch} AND auth_epoch=#{authEpoch}
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('decision_id',decision_id,'operation_id',operation_id,'template_version',template_version, 'template_sha256',template_sha256,'decision',decision,'from_status',from_status,'to_status',to_status, 'expected_revision',CAST(expected_revision AS CHAR),'resulting_revision',CAST(resulting_revision AS CHAR),'reason',reason, 'request',request_json,'baseline_manifest',baseline_manifest,'baseline_sha256',baseline_sha256, 'dependency_authorizations',dependency_authorizations,'receipt',receipt_json,'receipt_sha256',receipt_sha256, 'authority_grant',authority_grant,'authority_revision',CAST(authority_revision AS CHAR), 'auth_epoch',CAST(auth_epoch AS CHAR),'governance_epoch',CAST(governance_epoch AS CHAR), 'schema_version',schema_version,'schema_manifest_sha256',schema_manifest_sha256,'created_by',created_by, 'created_at',DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'classification',classification) AS content FROM template_approval_decision d WHERE decision_id=#{decisionId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND template_version=#{templateId} AND created_by=#{userId}
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{templateId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type='template.approval_decided'

SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE aggregate_id=#{templateId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type='template.approval_decided' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.decision.operation_id'))=#{operationId}
